description: Print the whole knowledge base (or the subtree at path) as one Markdown document, for a person who wants to read it. JSON nodes become code blocks. Long output is cut at max_bytes; then export a child path. To look things up yourself use memory instead. Errors: NodeMissing, PathBad, MemoryMissing.

path.description: node path like me/self_tools; empty or / is the root (default)
